description: Authoritative secret-rotation policy for the feature-flags-api field app. Every secret is ENV-INJECTED only: the process reads credentials exclusively from environment variables (server.mjs loadTenantTokens reads WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS; values never touch tracked source). This file declares NAMES, ownership, and rotation hygiene ONLY — it contains zero secret VALUES by construction.

secrets.name: WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS
secrets.description: Composite JSON env var consumed by server.mjs loadTenantTokens(): a {tenantId -> bearer-token} map. The single place credentials enter the process. Absent/blank => deny-by-default (every request 401s). Values are injected by the deploy platform; never committed.

secrets.name: API_TOKEN_TENANT_A
secrets.description: Per-tenant bearer token for tenant A. Injected into the composite WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS map at deploy time; presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and compared in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual). Name only — value is never stored here or in any tracked file.

secrets.name: API_TOKEN_TENANT_B
secrets.description: Per-tenant bearer token for tenant B. Injected into the composite WALTEUR_TENANT_TOKENS map at deploy time; presented as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and compared in constant time. Name only — value is never stored here or in any tracked file.

static_secret_scan.scope: tracked source/config under WALTEUR_ROOT (.ts/.js/.mjs/.json/.env/.yml/... ), pruning node_modules/.git/walteur-kit
